findings.highlight: I don’t want them to spoil
findings.evidenceJa: 甘やかすのはよくない
findings.governingReading: It would not do to spoil her
findings.explanation: Shirou’s resolve not to indulge Rin becomes an apparent concern that the eggs and soup might spoil.

findings.highlight: went out by herself and never returned
findings.evidenceJa: 一人で街に出て、それきり帰ってきてない
findings.governingReading: went into town alone and still has not come back
findings.explanation: The concrete possibility that Rin went into town disappears from Shirou’s escalating worry.
